first_sentence: 草上有露水，是因為晚上空氣變冷。
facts: 露水是水氣碰到冷的草葉變成的
露水常在清晨的草上看到
太陽出來後，露水會慢慢變成水氣

bridges.has_dog: 早上帶狗狗去散步，草上會有露水喔。

question_patterns: why is there dew on the grass
why is the grass wet in the morning
en.first_sentence: Dew forms on grass because the air gets cold at night.
facts: Dew is water from the air that touches cold grass.
You often see dew on grass early in the morning.
When the sun rises, dew goes back into the air.
en.ask_back: Do you think dew is on the grass at noon, or in the morning?

bridges.has_dog: Has your dog ever run through wet grass in the morning?
